title: Uranium Royalty: Diversified Portfolio of Uranium Royalties and More to Come in 2024
summary: Uranium Royalty Corp. is a pure-play uranium royalty company focused on gaining exposure to uranium prices by making strategic investments in uranium interests, including royalties, streams, debt and equity investments in uranium companies, as well as through holdings of physical uranium. The Company's strategy recognizes the inherent cyclicality of valuations based on uranium prices, including the impact of such cyclicality on the availability of capital within the uranium sector and the current historically low uranium pricing environment.

## Uranium Royalty: Diversified Portfolio of Uranium Royalties and More to Come in 2024


Mar 6, 2024


An interview with URC CEO Scott Melbye with Swiss Resource Capital AG at PDAC 2024 in Toronto. Uranium Royalty is the only royalty company in the uranium sector and has a very broad portfolio and a lot of experience and contacts in the commodity segment. The portfolio is to be significantly expanded in 2024, the company can rely on the sale of physical uranium for financing, of which it holds 2.5 million pounds. Uranium Royalty is therefore ideally positioned for the current and ongoing bull market.
